objective.title: Profitability x Valuation signal discovery
objective.description: Discover symbolic equity-return signals that use both themes (profitability and valuation) for Profitability x Valuation. The signal should capture an interaction beyond an isolated single-theme effect. Economic story: Highly profitable firms that are also cheap combine strong fundamentals with low market expectations. The task is to identify signals where profitability strengthens value rather than merely relabeling either effect.
